login.tagline: Sign in to validate tickets at the gate
login.title: Welcome back
login.footer: Scanner accounts only. Need access? Contact your event organizer.

accessDenied.title: Access denied
accessDenied.description: This app is for scanner accounts only. Contact your organizer if you need access.

auth.twoFactorRequired: Two-factor authentication is required. This app does not support 2FA yet.

forgot.title: Forgot password?
forgot.description: Enter your scanner account email. We will send a 6-digit code if the account is eligible.
forgot.securityNote: For your security we always show the same confirmation message — we never reveal whether an email is registered.
forgot.successFallback: If the account exists, a verification code has been sent to your email.

verify.title: Enter verification code
verify.description: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Codes expire in 15 minutes.
verify.codeHint: Enter all 6 digits — no spaces required.
verify.resendSuccessFallback: If the account exists, a verification code has been sent.

new.title: Choose a new password
new.description: Create a strong password with at least 8 characters for your scanner account.

otp.expired: Code expired — request a new one below.

camera.isOffDescription: Turn the camera back on to scan QR codes, or use manual entry for ticket codes.
camera.fixPermissions: Fix camera permissions above, or enter a ticket code manually.
camera.denied: Camera access was denied. Use manual entry instead.
camera.startFailed: Could not start the camera on this device.
camera.alignQr: Align the QR code within the frame
camera.oneScanHint: One scan per ticket — wait for the result before scanning again
camera.srPaused: Camera paused while validating or showing a scan result.
camera.srActive: Camera active. Point at a ticket QR code.

manual.title: Enter ticket code
manual.description: Paste a ticket code (e.g. TIC-…) or the full QR JSON payload. Validation uses the live scanner API for the selected event.
manual.label: Ticket code or payload

result.checkingDescription: Please wait while we validate this scan.
result.validBody: Ticket is valid for this event.
result.usedBody: {{holderName}} — this ticket was already scanned for {{eventName}}.

toasts.deviceNotRegistered: Device not registered. Sign in again.
toasts.invalidQr: Invalid QR — no ticket code found.
toasts.wrongEvent: This ticket is for a different event.

validation.otpInvalid: Enter the 6-digit code from your email
validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.scanValidationDefault: Ticket not found or could not be validated.

scanFailure.scanner_not_assigned: Scanner is not assigned to this event.
scanFailure.scanner_not_owned_by_event_organizer: This scanner account is not authorized for this event's organizer.
scanFailure.ticket_from_other_event: This ticket is for another event.
scanFailure.before_window: Entry is not open yet for this event.
scanFailure.ticket_status_invalid: Ticket status is not valid for entry.
